channels.title: Channel manager
channels.intro: Sell your rooms on Booking.com, Expedia, Airbnb and other sites through Channex. Connecting creates your property, room types and the rate plans you choose there; prices, availability and bookings then stay in step.
channels.off: No channel manager is set up for this platform yet.
channels.fake: This is a test setup: nothing is sent to a real channel manager.

status.PAUSED: Paused: nothing is sent or taken in

channels.plansHint: Each plan is set up once per room type it sells. A plan you leave out stops being sent.

sync.title: Prices and availability
sync.checked: Up to date at {{when}}: changes go within about a minute.
sync.notYet: Nothing sent yet: the first send starts within a minute.
sync.fullPending: Sending everything again: this takes a few minutes.
sync.fullAt: Everything last sent again at {{when}} (this runs daily).

bookings.title: OTA bookings
bookings.checked: Bookings checked at {{when}}: new ones come in within about a minute.
bookings.notYet: No bookings checked yet: the first check runs within a minute.
bookings.error: Taking bookings in stopped: {{message}}. It tries again every minute.
bookings.none: Every booking from the OTAs is on the calendar.
